Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title states the main change: the fleet name is now included in the role activity when a user is created with fleet roles. It matches the summarized changes in server/service/users.go and the linked issue. The title is 78 characters, which is within a reasonable length for a single-sentence title.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template's main sections: it links the related issue (Resolves `#59514`), explains the cause and the fix, lists the changes file as checked, and documents added testing. It includes the required AI section with tool and model. Some checklist items are unchecked: manual QA is not done, and the description does not include a database migration or Apple MDM note, which do not apply here. The description does not state the changes file path or name, but the checklist shows it was added. Overall the description is mostly complete.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#59514`] requires that creating a user with fleet roles logs changed_user_fleet_role with the fleet's name in fleet_name. The root cause is that CreateUser loads TeamsSummary but keeps only IDs, so the payload's fleet.UserTeam entries have an empty Name, and LogRoleChangeActivities (server/fleet/activities.go, ActivityTypeChangedUserTeamRole.TeamName) reads that Name. Per the PR summary, server/service/users.go now copies the payload's team assignments, fills each Name from the datastore team summary, and stores the named copy before user creation. The unknown-ID invalid-argument error is kept. server/service/users_test.go adds TestCreateUserTeamRoleActivityHasTeamName, which asserts the activity carries the fleet ID and name. The only coding requirement is this fleet name fix, and the summary establishes it. Limitation: the repository diff for server/service/users.go could not be read (changed blobs missing from checkout), so the conclusion rests on the PR summary and PR description, not on a direct hunk read. No parent or contextual issues apply.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The PR changes three paths per the summary: a changes/ entry (+1 line), server/service/users.go (CreateUser copies team assignments and fills names), and server/service/users_test.go (adds one test and an activity API import). All of these serve the single objective of [`#59514`]. The PR description states that nothing else changes, and the summary lists no unrelated edits. The caller's slice is not mutated because a copy is made, which is a direct part of the fix.
